ModMetaData.name: The Ark
ModMetaData.author: Joe McDonagh
ModMetaData.description:
The Ark is a nomadic gravship total conversion for RimWorld.
The ship is the colony.
Land. Explore. Salvage. Survive. Escape.
M1: Persistent campaign foundation. M2/V1.1: Dev Mode campaign debug UI + New Game playtest scenario (The Ark). M3: Landing detection (session + LandingNumber); Dev Mode Simulate Landing for surface playtest. M4: Landing timer (ticks while session active); Dev Advance Landing Timer +1 Day. M5/M6: Pursuit rises +1 per landed day; band letters QUIET→HARBINGER.
Playtest scenario uses Biotech Baseliner crew (ConfigurePawnsXenotypes). Odyssey enables real gravship land detection; Simulate Landing works without a hop.
Install note: only one folder may use packageId joemcdonagh.theark. Prefer Mods\the-ark-rimworld (McRimworld junction). Remove Mods\TheArk if present.
